name: yuryalencar-paper-skills
description: Claude Code skills for writing academic papers by Yury Alencar Lima — installable anywhere.

plugins.name: organize
plugins.description: Set up a new paper project from the venue's own format: reads the author guidelines, fetches the official template, and scaffolds a LaTeX project that compiles, with optional GitHub and Overleaf.

plugins.name: ask-paper
plugins.description: The paper-writing helper: explains every skill and when to use it, reports where the manuscript stands and what to write next, and keeps session state across weeks.

plugins.name: write
plugins.description: Write or update one paper section in LaTeX (abstract, introduction, results and discussion, conclusions, title, cover letter, response to reviewers) from the course-derived model for that section.

plugins.name: draft
plugins.description: Draft one paper section, or a skeleton of the whole paper, from the material you already have, with red TODOs wherever the section's model needs something you have not supplied.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Review one paper section against the course-derived model for that section and report what is missing, weak or inconsistent, without rewriting it unasked.

plugins.name: paper-writing-style
plugins.description: House style rules for scientific paper writing in English, distilled from Zucolotto's scientific writing course.
